summary: Round 1 findings ADV-P1-1, -2, -3, -4 and -6 are resolved. The restored commission FAQ case fails on every en and th mutant. The four errata are true and complete. The class sums, the structure checks, and nine classification mutants pass. The bounded sample of three D5 live-line pins found a new loss. The pricing S7 body, the pricing S9 answer 2, and tutorRole.points.3 (th) have no test at HEAD. A plain typo from 3,000 to 3,500 in the S7 body passes all 58 sampled HEAD files. The a1caa5803 tests caught each of the three pins. This is one Blocker, ADV-P1-8.
blocking_findings: ADV-P1-8 [Blocker] adversarial: Three of three sampled D5 pins that carry price or commission text have no test at HEAD. Method (adversarial-p1-fdf62c9-sample-run.py): one mutation in a /tmp copy of the app, 58 HEAD test files that reference locale, pricing or tutor modules, and three a1caa5803 files as controls. The control run has 67 environment failures, all in real-logos-captures-adversarial. Pin S7 (pricing.ts S7 body, 'Packages start at 3,000 baht' changed to 1,200 baht in en and th): no HEAD test fails; five a1caa5803 cases fail. A plain typo to 3,500 gives the same result. Pin S9 (pricing.ts S9 answer 2, 'No. Printed workbooks are priced separately' changed to 'Yes ... included in the school price'): no HEAD test fails; five a1caa5803 cases fail. Pin P3 (tutorRole.points.3 in th, 'the calculator shows examples' changed to 'shows the money you will actually get'): no HEAD test fails; 'holds the new th copy at both paths' fails at a1caa5803. The S7 and S9 English sentences appear in no HEAD test file. They appear only in the fixture (TH-FP-80, TH-FP-87), and the fixture feeds one length control (PRICING_ENTRIES.length equals 37). The K case 'shows no other baht amount than the FR-9 and FR-10 figures' (www-pricing-page.content.test.tsx:306) forbids only '1,000' and '1,500' and requires '3,000' somewhere on the page. The report line 'Money pins stay as K' and the 407c5d9bd line 'the 3,000 floor ... guard money facts' do not hold for these pins. The D5 erratum covers faq.items.5.answer only. Rationale: Review A rated the same loss class as Blocker in F9 (claim limits), F12 (price and date), and round 1 ADV-P1-1. Fix: Green restores exact en and th assertions for the fact-bearing price and commission statements (pricing S7 body, S9 answer 2, S9 answer 3, features S5 body 3, tutorRole.points.3 th), with one breakage proof each, and corrects the report line. The report rule applies to the other D5 rows too: a pin that carries a baht figure, a commission or payout rule, a price-inclusion claim, or a claim limit stays exact. This pass did not sweep those rows. Or the PM records a disclosed exception for the residual, as for ADV-P1-4.

All three restores (fb5622ed7 for explicit-English and Primary, 9eb3b9c4f for navigation) belong to task 2.7, which is Phase 2. Both commits precede adf24e723, the Phase 3 R2 commit. It forbids two literals and requires '3,000' somewhere on the page. The same body existed at a1caa5803, so the name predates the track. Fix: rename it, or widen it to the figure list.
